text:
sam: Quick note from a short VoiceOver + keyboard sweep on the models dashboard. Found a timing/announcement nit when closing the details flyout while the list re-renders. Posting small repro and suggestions.

erin: Thanks 1 repro steps? I can try locally.

sam: On staging: tab to a row, press Enter to open details panel, while panel open trigger a short search/filter so virtualized list re-renders, then press Esc to close. VO sometimes announces the next row's name or says nothing. Looks like focus restore runs before the new DOM settles.

kai: I can repro on mac+VO. Also NVDA sometimes announces the panel close twice because we have both a toast and a panel status message.

a11y-bot: Heuristic hints: avoid restoring focus to an element that may be replaced by virtualization; use a temporary focus anchor or defer focus restore until after render commit. Consolidate announcements to a single live region to avoid duplicate polite reads.

erin: Proposed lightweight fix: insert a focus-anchor span with stable id next to the logical list position before opening; focus the anchor instead of the row while panel is open; on close, focus the anchor and then remove it after a short settled timeout or when the virtualizer reports stable. Pseudocode: 
```
const anchor = document.createElement('span');
anchor.tabIndex = -1; row.after(anchor); anchor.focus(); // on close anchor.focus(); setTimeout(()=>anchor.remove(), 150);
```

sam: That should work. Also for announcements we should only announce panel open/close from the central live region: "Opened details for <model>" and "Closed details for <model>". Avoid role/status on multiple elements.

kai: After PR I'll run VO + NVDA passes and a quick keyboard-only matrix. My checklist: focus anchor prevents wrong announce, no duplicate toasts, Esc closes and announces closed text, and focus-visible ring is visible in dark mode.

erin: I'll draft PR with focus-anchor utility and single-live-region announcement. Will tag @kai for testing.

sam: Thanks. Owners: Erin (impl), Kai (QA), Sam (acceptance). Goal: deterministic focus/announce behavior even with virtualization and quick filter changes.
